objective: Close or precisely disclose RT-J2-O4, RT-J3-O2 and RT-J3-O3 under the seventh static successor condition, preserving custody and no scientific authorization.
scope: Standing user authorization applies; no user confirmation required.
Administrative repair only for existing EXP-JINV-bd141d prerequisites; zero scientific runs, no target or curve access, no new experiments, no witness intake, no hypothesis or goal status change.
Preserve all historical records and queues. BATCH-bde652 legacy verification remains defective; this successor never rewrites hashes or commit messages.
No Bedrock, no silent inference fallback. All process watchdogs checkpoint; routine spending estimates are advisory.
Do not revert others; write only declared paths; workers never commit.
invocation_rule: Every executable invocation in v3 procedure, including capture and reviewer examples, uses an explicitly verified trusted absolute executable path. Use /bin/sh for the frozen v2 script. Verify executable and host ownership metadata, record path rather than trusting command -v from modified PATH. Do not fork the frozen emitter.

order: Reject absent, JSON null and non-string values as unusable.
Trim exactly the listed leading/trailing codepoints.
Preserve host_id case; lowercase filesystem_id and strip its trailing slashes; strip filesystem_mount trailing slashes except root /.
STOP if normalized string is empty or equals null case-insensitively; otherwise this presence rule passes, without asserting binding authenticity or mount syntax.
residuals: Finite codepoint set is NOT all Unicode Default_Ignorable_Code_Point; other invisible characters remain outside this repaired set.
A legitimate string null/NULL/Null is deliberately rejected fail-closed; document this false positive in the rule itself.
Interior characters are preserved, including interior zero-width characters; this rule does not validate hostname syntax.
Self-attestation and malicious runtime trust remain outside scope; independent mount verification remains required.

controls.fixed_battery: One deterministic defensive control battery; no adaptive scientific trials.
controls.invocation: Run the repaired absolute invocation under normal PATH and PATH prefixed by a task-local harmless sh sentinel. Sentinel only writes a local marker and exits; never forges a receipt. Require sentinel unexecuted, successful emitter, equal host_binding fields excluding timestamp. Do not execute the historical vulnerable invocation.
controls.presence: Freeze test vectors in source before running: absent; JSON null; integer; empty; each ASCII trim character; each of five zero-width singleton characters; mixed edge trim; literal null/NULL/Null; ordinary host; unusual device; root mount; trailing device/mount slashes; meaningful interior zero-width. Cover all three field rules and report every raw/normalized value and expected/actual outcome.
controls.policy: Static checks preserve caller-supplied/missing/v1 receipt STOP controls under predecessor binding_rule_v2; do not claim the new presence rule implements the entire schema.
controls.negative: Use a deliberately nonmatching expected hash and a wrong path/hash pairing against the custody checker; reject both without changing source files.

completion_gate: All declared files exist; controls report exact command/environment/stdout/stderr and resource measurements or honest unavailable fields.
All predictions checked with zero silently omitted cases; report failures without retries to obtain preferred outcome.
Historical v1 drift disclosed; original blob hashes verified from custody receipt; no old bytes edited.

outcome_branches.positive: After independent reviews pass, record scoped protocol repair/disclosure and return to existing experiment prerequisite selection; no science enabled automatically.
outcome_branches.negative: Archive failed controls and specific defect; Coordinator revises exact faulty interface additively.
outcome_branches.inconclusive: Archive precise missing host dependency or measurement; next action names that prerequisite.
